requirements_1_to_8.1: AuthFilter +10; admin deny by default outside login/error/assets; user protected cart/checkout/orders plus POSTlogout; invalid identities302; valid stamp wrong role403; public catalog stays readable
requirements_1_to_8.2: Both forms username stripped/codepoint1-50; nonempty password used verbatim; BCrypt/no absent-account message distinction; invalid fields400; usable but invalid credentials200same message
requirements_1_to_8.3: changeSessionId and exact UTC LocalDateTime record; CSRF retained; redirect303 to ReturnUrlPolicy-resolved local GET, no response model exposure
requirements_1_to_8.4: POSTlogout requires earlier identity+CSRF then invalidates this application session; user303/; admin303/login with fixed RedirectView, policy not relaxed
requirements_1_to_8.5: Database lookup per protected request; status and exact stamp checked before role. No new business write transactions in scope; future Service user-row-lock recheck remains later work
requirements_1_to_8.7: Unimplemented protected routes stay controller-free: auth intercepts anonymous, valid identity proceeds to normal 404/405 according to mapping/method
requirements_1_to_8.8: Existing BusinessException/GlobalExceptionHandler/Thymeleaf500 protections reused; no security starter/framework added

resolved_findings.finding: Admin static asset predicate initially excluded bare /css,/js,/images while user /** matcher included them
resolved_findings.resolution: Root requested zero-segment alignment before source publication; admin AuthFilter now explicitly permits each bare prefix and descendants; manifest refreshed

resolved_findings.finding: Role403 stable business code differed between candidates
resolved_findings.resolution: Root requested common AUTH_ROLE_FORBIDDEN before publication; admin code aligned; no prior committed error contract changed

accepted_implementation_differences: SessionIdentity record accessors userId()/authStamp() match both. User adds JavaBean getter aliases; root explicitly accepted no need to add redundant aliases to admin
User LoginController reads MultiValueMap, admin reads request parameter arrays. Both reject duplicate credential fields400 and fall back for missing/duplicate/unsafe returnUrl without400
Username input validation uses equivalent codepoint counting: shared InputChecks in admin, explicit same rules in user
Presentation error variable names and optional logout data marker differ; both real forms target POST/logout and expose stable login page/error markers
nonblocking_limitations: This review is static. Actual HTTP statuses, cookie independence, exact timestamp retention, role403 views, URL rewrite removal and zero database writes must be established by the independent real-JAR verification

The given database timestamp/role recheck cannot revoke a business transaction already committed. Business row-lock recheck, TST39 admin status endpoint and concurrent customer-disable behavior remain later scope
No full browser accessibility/security audit or production load assessment is claimed; group-member human cross-review is still pending before M3
